title: FOX Rehabilitation - Videos
description: FOX Rehabilitation is a primarily clinician-operated, professional private practice of physical and occupational therapists, speech-language pathologists, and fitness specialists, built on the foundation of Geriatric House Calls™. We treat our patients with physical and cognitive impairments compassionately and with positive outcomes.
